resources.string: Others won\'t see that you read their messages, are typing or are online. Sending a message still marks the chat as read on the server.
Messages that others delete stay on this device and are marked as deleted. Earlier versions of edited messages are available in the message menu. Only messages already loaded on this device are kept.
Premium, Stars, Business and gifts in settings
Showing stories again takes effect after restarting the app.
Up to 4 accounts and Premium app icons. Limits checked by Telegram servers (folders, pinned chats, upload size, speed) can\'t be changed by the app.
The system font applies after restarting the app. Font size, bubble corners, chat list layout and custom themes are in Settings → Chat settings.
